actions: As operator, create a separate document-export template with four local validate, decision, execute and report injections and a declaration of all supporting local instructions.

Define explicit source document, output format, authorized destination, source readability/export capability, authority constraints, export intent and artifact verification, and the configured customer-portal reporting procedure.

Declare private tool configuration, record root, canonical shared resources, ownership facility, authority sources and reporting/reconciliation capabilities; resolve the full local instruction closure.

Exercise nominal, invalid, outage, uncertainty, resume and contention cases; review/publish an identifiable operator-controlled version while retaining bound old versions. Activation/deployment requires separate authorization.
records: Preserve the export-specific contract and its review/exercise evidence; do not inherit Facebook actions, account access or a mandatory email channel.
The bundled export illustration is not a deployed service; untested capabilities remain unproven.
outcome: Document-export customization follows the generic lifecycle with its own complete local injections; publication alone does not activate it.

actions: Identify missing decision constraints using the four-injection checklist.
Keep the proposed template visibly incomplete; hold execution and do not claim ready or activate it.
Have the operator define the acceptance/rejection and authority constraints in a separate customization context before review.
records: Record the missing decision constraints as incomplete-service-definition and preserve the proposed definition and required next action.
outcome: Template remains incomplete and cannot be accepted for execution.

actions: Do not amend the running skill, injections, templates or helpers, even when the improvement is approved only in principle.
File a separate attributable improvement request through the configured operator route for operator evaluation and implementation in a separate change context.
records: Include request ID, bound version, problem and evidence, proposed change and impact.
Preserve the running request's original history and instruction/configuration binding.
outcome: Improvement is routed separately; executor self-editing is held.

actions: Report missing-customization-resource identifying the required unavailable bundled resource.
Hold the dependent customization review/completion and keep readiness unconfirmed.
Do not load another skill or invent substitute instructions; obtain the required bundled resource before continuing.
records: Preserve the missing-resource observation and the next action to restore the required bundled resource.
outcome: Customization is blocked on the missing required resource.

actions: Preserve the supplied approved caption, image, feed placement, eligible timing, publication authority and resolved PAGE-A identity.

Apply remaining configured capability/configuration and local-binding checks under exclusive request ownership; persist affirmative acceptance of that exact scope before execution and invoke acceptance reporting.
Under canonical shared-profile ownership, select PAGE-A and verify acting identity, exact caption, correct single image, feed-only placement and approved timing in the final native composer.
Persist pre-submit intent and attempt identity, submit the authorized native action once, inspect native post/schedule acceptance evidence, record the observed result and invoke outcome reporting.
records: Retain owned-Page resolution evidence identifying Example Page as PAGE-A, original inputs and authority, full binding identities, acceptance, ownership, pre-action intent and attributable native result evidence.
Retain each communication obligation and acknowledgement separately; if native acceptance is unconfirmed, preserve uncertainty and hold repeats/dependent effects pending reconciliation.
outcome: Eligible exact PAGE-A request proceeds through acceptance and one authorized submission; success is recorded only from native acceptance evidence.

actions: Treat explicitly authorized supported Chrome as eligible and use its configured profile and current API documentation.
Use the satisfied upload prerequisites; continue the remaining lifecycle checks without requiring internal iab or loading a shared browser skill.
records: Preserve explicit Chrome authorization/profile configuration and observed satisfied upload prerequisites; retain iab unavailability as an observation, not a Chrome blocker.
outcome: Browser prerequisites pass for configured Chrome despite unavailable iab.

actions: Use the configured authorized customer portal's documented submission procedure to report the actual outcome with request ID, resolved Page, confirmed effects/evidence, available native reference, reason and next action.
Retain the request-specific receipt acknowledgement as submission evidence; do not infer delivery or reading.
For an unknown submission, reconcile the same incident/attempt through authoritative portal evidence before any resend.
records: Keep report content, obligation/incident ID, attempt ID, portal receipt/native acknowledgement and communication status separate from execution outcome.
outcome: Customer-portal reporting is valid; acknowledged submission is preserved without claiming customer reading.

actions: Reject with the concrete reason missing required final caption; preserve that the caption was absent rather than explicitly supplied.
Do not write replacement copy or submit a post.
Promptly invoke configured rejection reporting with request ID, actual reason, confirmed effects and the next action for the requester to supply the exact final caption.
records: Preserve exact original inputs, missing-caption validation finding, rejection decision and separate reporting evidence or pending obligation.
outcome: Rejected for absent final caption; no task submission.

actions: Record identity-mismatch and hold final submission because the accepted destination is PAGE-A and the composer acts as PAGE-B.
Correct acting identity only within accepted PAGE-A authority and current profile ownership, then revalidate the entire final scope before any submission; never change the approved target to PAGE-B.
Promptly report any unresolved identity blocker and required intervention through the configured route.
records: Preserve accepted PAGE-A target, observed PAGE-B acting identity, mismatch evidence, submission hold and correction/revalidation or intervention next action.
outcome: Submission is held until the composer verifiably acts for accepted PAGE-A.

actions: Stop the upload-dependent task and record the browser's actual disabled local-file permission blocker.
If observed during validation, hold acceptance/execution for unavailable upload capability; if a tool upload call failed, record failed execution with no automatic retry.
Immediately invoke configured intervention reporting requesting operator resolution of the required upload permission.
Do not change browser permissions, diagnose missing credentials without evidence, switch backend, substitute media or continue a draft lacking the required image; keep the request resumable.
records: Retain actual browser rejection/failure evidence, supplied asset reference, blocked permission, confirmed earlier work, report attempt/status and next operator intervention.
outcome: Upload-dependent posting stops; operator intervention is required and promptly reported.

actions: Preserve confirmed native post acceptance as completed execution and do not republish.
Record the configured communication service outage and retain completion reporting as a discoverable pending obligation.
Expose the reporting gap through any available authorized requester route without substituting an unauthorized route/identity or inventing a credential diagnosis.
On recovery, resume only unfinished reporting, reconciling any unknown send outcome before another send.
records: Retain native acceptance evidence/post reference, completed execution status, exact completion-report content, incident/attempt identity, outage evidence and pending communication next action.
outcome: Post remains completed with communication pending; fully reported success is not claimed.

actions: Compare the requested scheduling instant including timezone/offset against the observed current instant.
Record past-schedule, preserve the original instant and hold submission.
Invoke the immediate configured failure report identifying the past instant and required requester intervention; do not guess a replacement time or publish now.
records: Retain requested instant/timezone, observed current instant, past-schedule finding, submission hold, confirmed effects and separate report evidence or pending obligation.
outcome: Past-schedule exception; submission held and immediate failure reporting invoked.

actions: Record unsupported native scheduling capability and hold acceptance/task execution for the requested future instant.
Promptly invoke configured intervention reporting with the scheduling blocker and required operator action.
Do not build a scheduler, invent a wake-up trigger, claim scheduling from stored state or publish immediately.
records: Preserve exact future instant/timezone, evidence that no existing authorized tool can establish it, blocker, confirmed effects, reporting status and next intervention.
outcome: Scheduling is blocked; no scheduled or immediate post is submitted.

actions: Inspect the native draft under current ownership against the accepted one feed image post scope: exact Page/acting identity, caption, single specified image, placement and timing.
Ensure no comments, personal shares, Stories, crossposts, boosts or extra destinations/actions are included.
Persist exact pre-action intent, submit once only after final scope checks pass, inspect native acceptance evidence and invoke the configured outcome report.
records: Preserve explicit zero-follow-up scope, final draft observations, acceptance/authority, intent/attempt identity, native acceptance or uncertainty evidence and separate reporting status.
If native outcome is unknown, retain reconciliation and replay/dependency holds rather than infer success from submission alone.
outcome: Only the authorized single feed image post is submitted; no follow-up destinations or comments are performed.
